newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT- Nautica, Phillips-Van Heusen start.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- Nautica, Phillips-Van Heusen start.

text.p: -- Goldman Sachs said that analyst Margaret Mager initiated coverage of Nautica Enterprises Inc, adding the stock to the recommended list.
-- said Mager initiated coverage of Phillips-Van Heusen Corp with a rating of market perform.
-- further details were not immediately available.
-- Nautica stock was up 1-1/4 to 26-3/8 in morning trade.
-- Goldman Sachs later said it set a 12-month price target of $32 a share on Nautica.
-- said expects Nautica to post five-year earnings growth of 24 percent.
-- Expects Nautica to earn $1.02 a share in 1997 and $1.28 a share in 1998.
-- said Nautica has a well-positioned brand image, strong men's collection sales and efficient operations.
-- said Nautica's near-term growth will be driven by the new sub-brand, Nautica Competition.
-- Goldman said it expects Phillips-Van Heusen to earn $0.71 a share in 1997.
-- said Phillips-Van Heusen is in the process of a major restructuring.
-- said sees "little upside" over the next 12 months as Phillips repositions itself.
-- said Phillips may face near-term restraints on earnings as more stores close and marketing expenses increase.
